name: CBERS-4A Rural Roads Benchmark
description: A benchmark for rural road extraction from free 2 m CBERS-4A satellite imagery over the Anápolis/Goiás region, Brazil. It contains 40 non-overlapping 1.2 km windows, each with three independent ground-truth layers — manual photo-interpretation, OpenStreetMap, and Strava GPS tracks — plus predictions, score maps, and evaluation code. The dataset quantifies the OpenStreetMap coverage gap in rural areas and supports both zero-shot benchmarking and supervised fine-tuning. Companion to the paper "Rural Roads from Free Satellite Vision: A CBERS-4A Benchmark and the OpenStreetMap Gap" (SmartAgriVision @ SIBGRAPI 2026). See README.md for structure and licensing.
